title_zh: 大钟寺首用换乘环90天证伪试点
title_en: Dazhongsi First-use Transfer Loop: 90-day falsification pilot
site_question_zh: A口—1733—D口能否先靠实体导向与人工服务连续到达，再让使用者自愿开启多语或无障碍AI建议？
site_question_en: Can Exit A–1733–Exit D work first through physical wayfinding and human service before users voluntarily enable multilingual or accessibility AI advice?

phases.zh: 现场复核：分时路线、无障碍替代、站口运营状态、非机动车冲突、1733管理与维护责任。
phases.en: Field verification: time-sliced routes, accessible alternative, exit operating status, micromobility conflict, 1733 management and maintenance responsibility.
phases.gate_zh: 未取得运营与场地确认，或普通路线不成立，则不安装。
phases.gate_en: No installation without operational/site confirmation or a functioning ordinary route.

phases.zh: 非AI基线：实体图、临时纸面导向、人工台、暂停/申诉回执与一次撤场演练。
phases.en: Non-AI baseline: physical map, temporary paper wayfinding, human desk, pause/appeal receipt and one removal drill.
phases.gate_zh: 使用者不能在无App条件下完成到达，则先修普通服务。
phases.gate_en: If users cannot arrive without an app, repair the ordinary service first.

phases.zh: 限时首用：自愿触发的多语/无障碍建议，现场解释、纠正和立即关闭。
phases.en: Time-limited first use: opt-in multilingual/accessibility advice with on-site explanation, correction and immediate shutdown.
phases.gate_zh: 错误路线、身份追踪、无人接管或占用主线任一出现即停。
phases.gate_en: Stop on a wrong route, identity tracking, absent takeover or obstruction of the main line.

phases.zh: 四方共评：使用者、维护者、专业复核者与可被授权运营者分别判断可达、可懂、可维护与公平。
phases.en: Four-party review: users, maintainers, professional reviewers and a potentially authorised operator separately judge access, understanding, maintenance and fairness.
phases.gate_zh: 未关闭的高风险问题不能被平均得分抵消。
phases.gate_en: Unclosed high-risk issues cannot be offset by an average score.

phases.zh: 采用/暂停/退场：三种结论同权；设备、账号和数据退出，普通换乘恢复。
phases.en: Adopt/pause/exit: three equal outcomes; equipment, accounts and data leave, and ordinary transfer is restored.
phases.gate_zh: 每个新点位和时段重新授权，不自动复制。
phases.gate_en: Every new site and time window is authorised again; no automatic replication.

boundary_zh: 90天只是概念决策序列，不是获批工期、预算、采购或真实试点；具体责任人、点位、尺寸与时段均待授权和专业复核。
boundary_en: Ninety days is a conceptual decision sequence, not an approved programme, budget, procurement or real pilot; accountable people, sites, dimensions and time windows all await authorisation and professional review.
